name: Sawtooth Star
description: Sawtooth star quilt blocks, each an eight-pointed star with a square on point at its heart, the stars meeting tip to tip across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --k0: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3))); --k1: @pd(@p(var(--color4), var(--color5))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --s: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @var(--k0), @var(--k1)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--s)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--star); clip-path: @var(--star); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--gem); clip-path: @var(--gem); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --star: polygon(25% 0%, 50% 25%, 75% 0%, 75% 25%, 100% 25%, 75% 50%, 100% 75%, 75% 75%, 75% 100%, 50% 75%, 25% 100%, 25% 75%, 0% 75%, 25% 50%, 0% 25%, 25% 25%); --gem: polygon(50% 27%, 73% 50%, 50% 73%, 27% 50%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
